cards.question: From downtown Detroit, which direction do you travel through the tunnel to reach Windsor, Canada?
cards.answerExplanation: Windsor lies mainly south of central Detroit because the Detroit River bends along this stretch of the border. Canada is generally north of the United States, but not at every crossing.
cards.whyNow: A new Lake Ontario sign put Canadian geography into today’s news; the Detroit–Windsor crossing offers another counterintuitive look at the same border.

newsPegSources.headline: Canada installs large Lake Ontario sign in latest jab at US

cards.question: Iceland participates in the EU single market without being an EU member through which arrangement?
cards.answerExplanation: The European Economic Area extends the EU single market to Iceland, Norway, and Liechtenstein. Schengen concerns border-free travel, while the EEA covers the movement of goods, services, people, and capital.
cards.whyNow: Iceland’s referendum rejected renewed EU accession talks, highlighting how the country already participates in much of the single market without EU membership.

newsPegSources.headline: Iceland rejects EU accession talks after divisive referendum campaign

cards.question: Roman will map invisible matter by measuring subtle distortions in distant galaxy images. What produces those distortions?
choices: Telescope motion smearing the galaxy images
cards.answerExplanation: Mass curves spacetime, bending light that passes nearby. Measuring this weak gravitational lensing lets astronomers map matter—including dark matter—even when it emits no light of its own.
cards.whyNow: NASA launched the Roman Space Telescope today; one of its major tools for investigating the dark universe is measuring gravitational lensing across wide surveys of galaxies.

newsPegSources.headline: NASA’s Dark Universe-Seeking Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope Launches

cards.question: A country’s fertility rate stays below replacement level. What does “replacement” mean here?
choices: Each generation has enough children to replace itself
Every household has at least two children
The population cannot shrink during that year
Births and deaths are equal every month
cards.canonicalAnswer: Each generation has enough children to replace itself
cards.answerExplanation: Replacement-level fertility means each generation has enough children to replace itself over the long run. A population can still grow for a while because of age structure, and migration also changes the total.
cards.whyNow: A Global Voices analysis connected China’s fertility decline with modernization, bringing the often-misunderstood idea of replacement-level fertility into focus.

coreFactSources.title: Eight trends for a world of 8 billion people

newsPegSources.headline: China’s fertility crisis is evidence of its modernization success

cards.question: A spacecraft moves twice as far from Earth. All else equal, about what fraction of its radio signal power reaches the same receiving area?
cards.answerExplanation: Radio energy spreads across an area that grows with the square of distance. Doubling the distance spreads the same energy over roughly four times the area, leaving about one quarter for the receiver.
cards.whyNow: NASA brought a new Goldstone Deep Space Network antenna online today; large dishes help recover spacecraft signals that become extraordinarily faint across interplanetary distances.

coreFactSources.title: Antennas of the Deep Space Network

newsPegSources.headline: NASA Deep Space Network’s New Goldstone Antenna Goes Online
